chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about the man who commits adultery many times in one day. He said: If he commits adultery with one woman such and such number of times, then upon him is one Penalty (Hadd). And if he commits adultery with various women in one day, and in one time, then upon him is a Penalty (Hadd) for each woman he was immoral with.
ai.seo_question: How many Hadd penalties does a man incur for committing adultery multiple times in one day?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the jurisprudential distinction between the number of acts and the number of victims in determining the hadd penalty for zina. It establishes that while multiple acts with a single woman constitute one offense, each distinct woman involved in separate acts incurs an independent penalty, reflecting the principle of individual liability for each instance of transgression.
